title: A report that calls a failure "pre-existing" names a run on the base branch's tip
why: Lane silent-undo-ci-body (session_013NEJL4TDRWqka4aSU2Bv7L) called test SmallBaseMove pre-existing on 32b5f8b8e, which is #1712's own head, not main. That hid two red tests that reach #1726, #1743, #1753 and #1869 (coordinator, 03:51 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the report guard refuses a report that calls a failure pre-existing unless the same line names a run (id or URL) whose head is the base branch's tip, and a lane brief says the same. Red case first: a report naming a run on a PR head as pre-existing passes today; control: a report naming a run on main's tip passes. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator.
